Production and Installation of Industrial Equipment

We manufacture additional equipment for various production lines and systems used in the chemical, food, pharmaceutical, and related industries.

  • Conveyors and Rollers

    Rotating, lifting, with scrapers or endless belts.

  • Transition Bridges and Industrial "Tanks"

    (washing machines, rinse and cleaning tanks).

  • Silos for Bulk Materials

    We design according to customer requirements, considering the specifics of stored materials.

  • Equipment for Reception, Loading and Unloading

    Including specialized mechanisms for food plants.

In production, we use turning and milling machining, as well as modern welding technologies for high-alloy and low-carbon steels, aluminum, and titanium. We provide both the production of new equipment and the modernization of existing lines.

Our Realizations

Each of our projects reflects precise fulfillment of customer requirements, a well-thought-out economic model, and impeccable technical execution.

If you want to learn more about our completed works or discuss a future project, contact us in the way that is most convenient for you. We will be happy to share additional details and propose solutions perfectly tailored to your needs.
